Mad Libs Generator

Fill-in-the-blank story fun — pick from built-in Mad Libs templates, enter silly words, and read your hilarious story.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a story template.
  2. Fill in each blank with a silly word.
  3. Click “Generate story”.
  4. Read it aloud and copy it to share.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many stories are included?

5 complete story templates: a space adventure, a haunted house, a cooking disaster, a sports final and a pirate tale.

Do I need to know grammar?

Each blank tells you the word type needed (noun, verb, adjective…), so no grammar knowledge is required.

Can I copy my story?

Yes — copy your finished story to share it anywhere.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — fully mobile friendly.
